title: Exit tests that claim each sell, approval and anti-rug submit runs inside withNonceLock mock the lock as a pass-through and only count calls, so removing the lock from a signing site (including the exact INT-NONCE-SELL regression) keeps them green

evidence.note: withNonceLock mocked to record the address and call op() directly (no serialization)
Test 6 asserts withNonceLockCalls.length >= 3 and that every call used the wallet address
Test 9 asserts only that withNonceLock was called and that calls[0] used the wallet address
first lock on this path: the approval (allowance 0 < balance in both fixtures)
submitPrivateSell: the lock around escalatePrivateSell (the INT-NONCE-SELL fix)
public-fallback approval lock (:543) and swap lock (:552): the trailing-stop path takes four locks in total

sibling_sites_checked: Every unit test that mocks src/utils/nonceAuthority: exitInclusionLadder, antiRugReason, failedExitBalanceTruth (pass-through, but makes no lock claim), exitEngineSell.test.ts (pass-through; labelled in Task 2), exitWorker (spy that keeps the real lock), noDoubleSellReconcile, partialSellDecoupled, pollTelemetry (real lock via importActual). The real-lock tests sellNonceLock and exitWorkerRealPath do not pin the call sites either (AUD-TESTU-004).
severity_rationale: S2: a money-path test that replaces the mechanism it claims to prove (D-20 rubric); the hidden defect class is the S1 cross-submit nonce collision (WR-01, INT-NONCE-SELL) that already passed a green suite once.
recommendation: Phase 28: assert lock membership per signing site with the real withNonceLock (hold the lock from outside and observe that each named site, approval, private sell, public approval and public swap, does not start until it is released), not a call count.
affected_cases: exitInclusionLadder.test.ts: Test 6 (nonce-wrapped): the public fallback swap + approval each run inside withNonceLock(ctx.wallet.address, ...)
antiRugReason.test.ts: Test 9 (D-NONCE-AUTHORITY-ALL): the anti-rug-triggered exit submit routes through withNonceLock
escaped_regression: Change src/exitEngine.ts:909 back to calling escalatePrivateSell(txBuilder, ctx, attempts, gasMultiplier) directly (the INT-NONCE-SELL bug): antiRugReason Test 9 stays green because calls[0] is the approval lock at :874, and exitInclusionLadder Test 6 stays green with 3 calls (approval, public approval, swap) >= 3. Removing the swap lock at :552 also leaves Test 6 at 3 calls.
